description: fz-go4.18.12 finding 1 (dominant churn). A changed demand triggers invalidate_runtime_demand_dependents -> invalidate_demand_derived_products_one, which wipes dependents' memo entries UNCONDITIONALLY; they recompute to the same value. Measured (2x runs, 4 fixtures): RuntimeDemand re-productions byte-identical 58/65 (00181), 60/64 (00001), 13/15 (00026), 6/8 (escaped_callable); ExecutableEffects re-productions 100% identical (14/14, 21/21, 6/6, 5/5 — invalidate_artifact_products wipes them on every demand wobble). The equality check that exists (record_latest_runtime_demand) is used to START propagation but never to STOP it at unchanged hops. FIX: gate each propagation hop on the changed-check — an invalidation that recomputes to an identical value must not propagate further (monotone, semantics-preserving; this is memoization hygiene, not a lattice change). Locus: pull.rs invalidate_runtime_demand_dependents / invalidate_demand_derived_products_one / invalidate_artifact_products. ACCEPTANCE (minimal-job-trace doctrine): identical re-production counts drop to ~0 on the 4-fixture corpus; suite green 3x; job totals drop (00181 baseline 247).
title: Demand invalidation wipes the dependent cone unconditionally; stop propagation at unchanged nodes
